images.name: K0
images.prompt: Vintage pen-and-ink engraving illustration, fine cross-hatching and stippling, etched linework like a 19th-century book plate, with subtle muted watercolor washes in ochre, sage and faded red, on warm cream aged paper. The subject sits in the center surrounded by plain empty cream paper, no border, no frame. Animals drawn with correct natural anatomy. No text, letters, numbers, signatures or watermarks. A small brown hare standing calmly in front of a huge maned lion in a dry forest clearing, the lion looming over him, the hare looking up fearless and clever.
